description: CTO PERSISTENCE & REPRODUCIBILITY HARDENING V8 §3/§4: lock, with a committed isolated regression test, the reproducibility invariants that the V6/V7 incident closures depend on — (a) a NORMAL roadmap-driven regeneration (mission-contract-factory.generateMissing over the real ROADMAP) does NOT resurrect BUILD_RUNTIME (a dev/CI build id, not a roadmap mission) as an executable mission; (b) the factory never emits stale `.test.js` presentStateAcceptance probe paths (it emits no probe at all); (c) the durable proof mechanisms are committed/versioned (resolveByReconciliation + resolveObsoleteIncidents + the validation-engine cross-mission guard) and fail-closed (no probe / NOT_PROVEN ⇒ never resolved). Audit finding: no factory defect (BUILD_RUNTIME not in roadmap; probes hand-authored in gitignored contracts). This mission adds the regression lock; it changes NO production behaviour.

authorization.authorization_source: CTO PERSISTENCE & REPRODUCIBILITY HARDENING V8 §3 (isolated reproducibility test) + §4 (automated regression; source fix only if a generator reintroduces stale data).

work_item_contract.objective: An isolated (temp-sandbox, no user-worktree mutation) regression test asserting: normal roadmap regen does NOT generate BUILD_RUNTIME; factory buildContract emits no `.test.js` probe path; the committed durable mechanisms export their functions and stay fail-closed (NOT_PROVEN ⇒ no resolution).
work_item_contract.claim_reproduction_rootcause: AUDIT: V6/V7 closures live in gitignored local runtime state (incident ledger + mission contracts/probes). RISK (§4): a generator could resurrect BUILD_RUNTIME as executable or re-emit stale `.test.js`. FINDING: BUILD_RUNTIME is NOT in the ROADMAP ⇒ generateMissing never recreates it; the factory/synth emit NO presentStateAcceptance and NO `.test.js` ⇒ no generator reintroduces stale paths. No source defect ⇒ lock the invariants with a regression test.
work_item_contract.scope: One new isolated test under runtime/core (runs with the suite). Copies the real ROADMAP into a mkdtemp sandbox and runs the factory there; NEVER writes to the user worktree; cleans only its own temp dirs. No production code changed (audit found no defect). If the test had FAILED (e.g. BUILD_RUNTIME regenerated), a bounded factory source fix + this regression would follow.
invariants: Isolated: mkdtemp sandboxes only; NEVER touch the user worktree, ledger, or real contracts; cleanup limited to created temp dirs.
No existing data deleted/overwritten; 5 stashes preserved.
Asserts fail-closed (NOT_PROVEN/no-probe ⇒ no resolution) + cross-mission guard present.
Pure verification: no production behaviour change (audit found no generator defect).
acceptance_criteria: Test PASS: normal roadmap generateMissing (temp) does NOT emit BUILD_RUNTIME; buildContract output contains no `.test.js`; self-diagnostic exports resolveByReconciliation+resolveObsoleteIncidents; validation-engine cross-mission guard present (checks.crossMissionOk path); fail-closed (injected NOT_PROVEN reconciler ⇒ zero resolutions). Non-regression of the incident suites + tsc 0. User worktree untouched (git status unchanged apart from the new test+contract+boussole). Committed.
stop_conditions: The test would need to write to the user worktree or the real ledger/contracts.
A real generator defect is found that needs a source fix outside this write-set (then open a bounded fix).

objectives.goal: Committed isolated regression locking the reproducibility invariants (no BUILD_RUNTIME resurrection; no stale .test.js from the factory; durable fail-closed mechanisms); no production change; user worktree untouched.
done_when: Test PASS; non-regression; committed in write-set.

definition_of_done: An isolated reproducibility regression test is committed that locks: normal regen never resurrects BUILD_RUNTIME; the factory never emits stale .test.js probes; the durable proof mechanisms are present + fail-closed. No production behaviour changed; user worktree + stashes preserved; committed (no force).
